description: Compact decoder-performance figure data. Each quantiles_ms list holds n = min(samples, quantile_count) latencies at levels i / (n - 1), linearly interpolated and rounded to 4 significant digits. The first and last entries are the minimum and maximum; populations no larger than quantile_count list every sorted sample. Means, medians, and p99 use the full samples.
latency_definition: Readout-owning window commit minus its last required scheduled input.
